'''Equator City''' was a the biggest [[City/Legends|city]] and former [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] located on the [[Betu/Legends|Betu]] continent, at the latitute of the equator.

It was the Rodian capital until [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] became the [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] and moved the seat of power to his ancestral city of [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]]; he also purged the political influence of the former government based in Equator City.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Much of the city was controlled by criminal organizations.<ref name="guide" /> It had a gambling complex operated by the part of the cartel that was dedicated to money laundering, controlled by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. The [[Flip of the Credit]] casino was also based there.<ref name="SoESb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The city was also home to the prestigious concert hall known as the [[Holosseum]] in which [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] performed in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="SG">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>

It had one of the four legal [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on the planet.<ref name="guide" />
